audit.whatIsWrong: diff is "EVEN" and diffRating "5.5/10" while the Emerald+ win rate is 38.46% and every prose block (early/mid/late, whys[0..6]) describes a losing lane — late even opens "This stays bad."
audit.why: A 38.46% win rate with the page's own prose calling the lane unwinnable 1v1 cannot be labelled EVEN. Tryndamere's Bloodlust crit-heal plus Undying Rage (120/100/80s, unkillable window) beat Graves' 2-shell magazine in any extended trade, which is exactly what the existing text says.
audit.corrected: diff HARD, diffRating 7/10, carryRating 7.5/10, with breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t restated to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why sells Level 6 as a Graves spike ("Collateral Damage adds an execute") and phases[4].side is "Graves", but whys[4] on the same page says Undying Rage survives at 1 HP for 5s so the kill rarely converts.
audit.why: Collateral Damage (R, 100/80/60s, 1000 range) cannot execute through Undying Rage. Level 6 is a wash: Graves gains real burst, Tryndamere gains a 5-second immunity that eats it.
audit.corrected: Level 6 becomes Skill 5/10 in both layers, and phases[4].why states the Undying Rage denial and tells you to fire R after the ult ends.
sources: kit: Graves R 100/80/60 cd, 1000 range; Tryndamere R 120/100/80

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0].why is generic Graves boilerplate ("Four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off") and phases[0].side is "Graves", directly contradicting whys[0] and the packet chart, which both give Level 1 to Tryndamere.
audit.why: Spinning Slash is a 650-range dash on a flat 12s cooldown at rank 1 while Graves' Quickdraw (E) is 425 range on 16s. He closes from outside Graves' effective shotgun range and Graves has no escape charge yet, so the point-blank auto trade never happens on Graves' terms.
audit.corrected: Level 1 flips to Tryndamere 3/10 in both layers; phases[0].why states the 650-range Spinning Slash open. Level 3 flips to Skill 5/10 (the Smoke Screen blind window in whys[2] is real but conditional). dosFull[0].d is rewritten to match its own title about the reload window, using the 12s Spinning Slash cooldown.
sources: kit: Tryndamere E 12/11/10/9/8, 650 range; Graves E 16/15/14/13/12, 425 range

audit.why: breakdown.cooldowns already names Undying Rage as the matchup-defining cooldown and warns against spending E on poke. Nothing to correct.

audit.whatIsWrong: Packet flagged 3 suspect ability names ("Undying Rage's", "Pop Undying Rage", "His Spinning Slash").
audit.why: All three are false positives — the flagged substrings are the real Riot names with surrounding words attached. Undying Rage (R), Spinning Slash (E), Mocking Shout (W) and Bloodlust (Q) all appear correctly throughout the page.

edits.before: Four shells of buckshot win any level-1 face-off — trade autos point-blank where every pellet lands.
edits.after: He Spinning-Slashes on at 650 range and crits before you have E — hold the shells, don't contest melee.

edits.before: Collateral Damage adds an execute and a disengage knockback in one — hold it for either, never for chip.
edits.after: Collateral Damage chunks him, but Undying Rage holds 1 HP for 5s — fire it after the ult, not into it.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10, Tryndamere carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10, Tryndamere carry threat 7.5/10.

edits.before: Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10, Tryndamere carry threat 6/10.
edits.after: Hard matchup — difficulty 7/10, Tryndamere carry threat 7.5/10.

edits.before: Five seconds unkillable — save your kill damage for after it ends. Bait it, count it, then go.
edits.after: Reload before he closes — his Spinning Slash is a 12s dash, and a half chamber is a free spin-down.

notes: Level-chart rows 0, 2 and 4 were proposed as matched full+content pairs plus their ratings, as one atomic group; rows 1, 3, 5 and 6 already agree across both layers and with the packet chart, so they are untouched. The three packet-flagged suspect names are false positives — every ability name on this page matches the kit. Two things I did NOT touch: (a) whys[1] says 'you get your second ability' at Level 2 while phases[1].why says E comes online — both are consistent with a standard Q-then-E order, so I left it; (b) report[8] recommends 'anti-heal early into his sustain' — Bloodlust's heal is real and in the kit, so the advice stands, but the exact Grievous Wounds breakpoint is not derivable from the kit files and I did not invent a timing.
